- [ ] I have read and agree to follow Searchhh Quality Policy v1.

Every new non-merge commit must include the policy trailer below. Do not check this for someone else. Contribution requirements do not change the upstream license.

## Behavior and scope

- Requested behavior:
- Production files/symbols and reachable routes:
- Interaction inventory IDs and stable tags:
- Action → observable state/navigation/data assertion:
- Baseline commands/results and preexisting issues:
- Current-commit executed test/CI evidence:
- UI before/after images + source/route/test (or explicit non-UI reason):
- WebView/security/state/performance risks:
- Remaining blockers and exact next task:

No catalogue/runtime substitution, disabled tests, ignored failures, fabricated evidence or debt exemptions. Link `docs/QUALITY_IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT.md`.
